clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/search with groupParams.groupByField='cat', groupSize=2, strictGroupSize=true, limit=15
clean_repro.observed: API returns 15 results (all entities) instead of respecting groupSize=2 with strictGroupSize=true (should return max 10 results: 5 categories × 2 per category)

contract_refs: groupParams.strictGroupSize should enforce exact groupSize limit per group

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: Search HTTP handler → groupParams extraction → search execution → grouping logic missing strictGroupSize enforcement
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:strictGroupSize参数被API接受但未被强制执行。分组逻辑中缺少对strictGroupSize=true的严格校验,导致返回所有匹配结果而非按groupSize截断。这是参数处理不完整的真正缺陷

falsification.probe: Execute search multiple times with same parameters to verify consistent incorrect behavior
falsification.observed: API consistently returns 15 results (all entities) regardless of strictGroupSize=true setting, proving the parameter is ignored

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus
cognition_match.note: 命中开发者认知盲点:REST v2 API参数处理不完整。strictGroupSize参数被接受但未强制执行属于参数验证/执行缺失的已知问题模式

verdicts.rationale: 实际复现成功:HTTP 200返回15个结果(全部实体),未遵守strictGroupSize=true的语义要求(应返回最多10个结果:5个分类×每组2个)。源码接地证实:strictGroupSize参数被API接受但分组逻辑中缺少强制执行代码。语义上strictGroupSize=true应严格限制每组返回groupSize个结果,但API返回所有匹配结果。这是参数处理不完整的真正缺陷,属于REST v2 API参数验证不足的已知盲点
